artworks.title: Death of Hercules
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a mythological scene. One figure is on the ground surrounded by flames and smoke. The second figure stands to the right holding a staff, shield, and club. The environment includes rugged terrain, jagged rocks, buildings across a body of water, and dense clouds in the sky. The drawing features detailed linework and an inscription at the top.

artworks.title: Female Satyr Playing a Bagpipe
artworks.description: The image shows a mythical creature playing a wind instrument while seated on a stone block. The creature has distinct features, including pointed ears and long hair, and appears to have a satyr-like appearance. It is unclothed with muscular arms and goat-like legs ending in hooves. The background consists of tall grasses and plants, with a simple frame around the artwork and the initials "ISB" in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: Two Couples and a Fool
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals in a seated outdoor setting. The scene depicts multiple figures engaged in conversation or interaction, with a backdrop of trees and foliage. The attire of the figures suggests a historical or period setting. The central figure is surrounded by others who are gesturing, pointing, or leaning in towards each other, indicating a focal point of activity or discussion. Fine lines and shading are used to create texture and depth, particularly in the depiction of fabric and natural elements like the trees. The intricate details and linear style suggest a careful and deliberate artistic approach.

artworks.title: Two Couples and a Fool
artworks.description: This is a drawing of four figures in historical attire. The scene shows them seated outdoors. One person gestures with their hand. The others appear engaged, with varying expressions. The intricate details in their attire are carefully rendered. A tree with detailed foliage is in the background. The drawing uses fine lines and cross-hatching techniques typical of etchings from the Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Eve Seated
artworks.description: The image shows a seated nude figure depicted from the side in a three-quarter view. The person is seated with the right arm on the knee and holding an object in the left hand, while the head is turned slightly to the left. The person's facial features are not distinctly detailed, and they have long hair. The skin and muscular structure are prominently shown. The background features a detailed landscape with a castle or fortress at the base of mountainous terrain. Above the figure, an intricate pattern resembling scales and a snake is visible.

artworks.title: Three Months
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a series of detailed, small-scale scenes portraying rural life and activities. The drawing is divided into three horizontal strips, each depicting various scenes. The first strip illustrates agricultural activities and livestock care. The second strip shows scenes of leisure and communal gatherings near a river or pond. The third strip depicts fishery and textile activities. Each section is framed with decorative elements and inscriptions in German.

artworks.title: Three Months
artworks.description: The image features three horizontally arranged panels, each filled with scenes of agricultural activities and rural life, depicted in a traditional style highlighting detailed line work and intricate textures. The composition is highly structured, divided by decorative borders with textual panels on the right side of each strip. Close to us in the top panel, there are scenes of individuals working the land, possibly harvesting or sowing, with structures and natural landscapes appearing beyond. The horizon lines are implied through the layered progression of the scenery, with farm structures, trees, and rolling hills receding into the background. The middle panel continues the theme of agricultural labor, capturing figures engaged in what seems like reaping or gathering crops with a backdrop of smaller buildings and rolling fields extending into the distance. In the bottom panel, there appears to be further agricultural activity, with individuals tending to the land, and more rustic structures are seen beyond the immediate scene. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on the contrast between black ink and the light background to convey depth and detail. The style emphasizes fine lines and detailed engravings typical of older illustrative techniques, presenting a rich tapestry of rural life across the structured bands.

artworks.title: Three Months
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three horizontal panels depicting rural and agricultural scenes with intricate details. The top strip visualizes activities involving barrels, with figures engaged in carrying and filling barrels, and horses pulling carts of produce. The central strip illustrates various crafting and farming actions, like flax processing and woodworking, with a hearth visible in the background and laborers engrossed in their tasks. The lowest strip shows domestic and outdoor farming activities, possibly butchery and food preparation, with figures engaging with livestock and tools. Mythic or celestial imagery is interspersed in each scene, such as figures on clouds. Finely detailed borders include German text.

artworks.title: Saturn
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.4 × 3.4 cm (1 3/4 × 1 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts an elderly man holding a young child upside down by the ankle in his left hand. The man is walking and has a muscular body. His facial features include a prominent forehead, a long, bushy beard, and a partially bald head with hair at the sides. He wears a cloth draped across one shoulder, which ties around his waist. In his right hand, he holds a large scythe. The ground beneath him is textured, suggesting grass or foliage. Behind him, there is an intertwining of animal forms, including parts of a goat with horns and a serpent's tail. The top left corner of the image is inscribed with the word "SATVRNVS" and a symbol resembling the astrological sign for Saturn, while the top right corner features the year "1569" alongside the initials "ADB." The overall background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Jupiter
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.3 × 3.4 cm (1 11/16 × 1 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a bearded figure dressed in classical armor, a helmet with a feathered plume, and a flowing cloak. They are standing in a dynamic pose, holding a scepter in one hand and interacting with a fish at their feet. Beside them is a centaur-like creature, half horse and half human, reaching towards the figure. The drawing features detailed linework emphasizing the muscular build and intricate clothing of the main figure, as well as the textured fur of the centaur-like figure. The setting includes a pedestal beside the main figure, contributing to the classical and mythological atmosphere.

artworks.title: Mercury
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.2 × 3.2 cm (1 5/8 × 1 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure standing with various symbols and objects. The central figure wears a helmet with wings, holds a caduceus, and stands on a pedestal with one arm extended, pointing forward. This figure is accompanied by two cherubic figures seated on the ground, playing with different objects. In the background, there are classical architectural elements and musical instruments. The inscription "MERCVRIVS" and the symbol associated with Mercury are included above the figure's head. The drawing style is intricate with fine details, reminiscent of Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Sun
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.3 × 3.3 cm (1 11/16 × 1 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a bearded man standing with his body turned to the side, wearing a detailed robe, a crown, and a cape. His hair and beard are long. He holds an object in his right hand, and a lion rests at his feet. A column is to his right, and books or documents are stacked at its base. Various symbols are present near the top, with a detailed background.

artworks.title: Mars
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.2 × 3.3 cm (1 5/8 × 1 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays a standing figure wearing a helmet with a plume, a beard, a short tunic with a decorated breastplate, and a cape. The figure holds a sword in their right hand and a staff in their left hand. At their feet are a shield and other pieces of armor. A ram stands beside them. The background shows stone structures, and inscriptions above the figure include "MARS," a star, the date "1569," and the initials "AB."

artworks.title: Moon
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.4 × 3.2 cm (1 3/4 × 1 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a female figure standing alongside nautical elements. She is draped in flowing garments and her right hand is positioned as if gesturing towards a crescent moon. In the background, there is a large ship with tall masts, and in front of the woman is an oversized lobster or crustacean. Smaller ships can be seen in the distant waters. The artwork is executed in a monochrome palette.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a workshop scene with craftsmen sculpting busts or heads. They are gathered around a table with tools like hammers and chisels. One craftsman is chiseling a head on a platform, with baskets of finished sculptures nearby. The detailed etching technique adds depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures surrounding a large chest. Several individuals are examining or counting spherical objects within the chest. The scene includes detailed costumes, expressive stances, and gestures. Architectural elements like columns hint at an indoor setting. In front of the chest are open books and a helmet. Figures in the background are shown engaging in various activities. The image showcases careful attention to form and attire, suggesting historical or allegorical themes.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape scene with two figures. One figure is carrying the other on their back. The larger figure is holding a walking stick and the smaller figure is resting comfortably. Both figures wear simple tunics. The setting is a rustic, rural environment with lush vegetation, including a grapevine tree. The landscape includes a winding path through fields and hills with detailed lines and shading for depth and texture.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring allegorical figures in a mythological scene. The drawing shows a winged angelic figure with a bow and arrow, and a well-dressed woman with a rod, set amidst clouds. Below them, another female figure is posed dynamically, surrounded by objects like an anchor and compass. The detailing highlights the movement and drama of the scene, with flowing drapery and dynamic positioning of the figures adding richness and complexity to the composition.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: The image features a crowded kitchen scene with several figures engaged in various cooking and eating activities at a central table filled with meats and food items. Kitchenware hangs from the ceiling, and the scene is rendered in a monochromatic palette of brown and beige tones. In the foreground, a woman sits with a child on her lap, a dog lies on the ground nearby, and figures are positioned around and behind the table. Kitchen utensils and pots hang in the background to the left.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a domestic scene with two figures involved in a gathering. The drawing depicts a setting inside a room with a window on the left, a pitcher on a rectangular piece of furniture, and a table covered with a cloth on the right. The main figures appear to be engaged in an act of convivial interaction, with one figure sitting and gesturing while another stands behind. In the background, there are detailed patterned surfaces, creating a cozy atmosphere. The style of the drawing is traditional and pays attention to intricate details and texture.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: The image is a black and white etching showing several individuals in period clothing in front of a castle-like building. In the foreground on the right, a couple is seated on the ground. The man is reclined with his body mostly visible, and the woman is partially turned towards him. He wears a wide-brimmed hat with a feather, a fitted jacket, and breeches, with facial hair visible on his face, while the woman has an intricate hairstyle and wears a dress with a detailed, wide collar. They seem to be conversing closely. Nearby, to the left, another seated couple can be seen, with the man holding a goblet and wearing a ruffled collar and patterned sleeves. The woman beside him, with her hair adorned simply, appears to be serving or interacting with him while holding a jug and a metal plate. Behind them stands another woman, shown in full-length, with an elaborate dress that includes layers of fabric and fur trim. In the background is a large architectural structure resembling a castle or manor house with rounded towers and visible stonework, surrounded by trees. The scene conveys a sense of a leisurely afternoon in a courtyard or garden setting adjacent to the building.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an outdoor gathering scene. In the forefront, an animated figure engages in a dance or playful activity, surrounded by a semicircle of people. Spectators are seated on benches while others stand watching. On the left, a figure holds a musical instrument. In the distance, a group of smaller figures make a procession or dance along a winding path leading to a village with thatched-roof buildings. The background shows rolling hills, a tree canopy, and a communal village atmosphere.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a small interior setting. On the left, a standing man is shown in profile, extending his right hand toward a seated woman on the right. He is wearing a distinctively patterned outfit with puffed sleeves and breaches, featuring vertical stripes and decorative elements, a long vest with large buttons, and a wide-brimmed hat with a floppy top. The woman is seated, facing the man, and appears to be holding a small round object, possibly a fruit. She has elaborate neck ruff and sleeves with spotted patterns, a voluminous skirt, and her hair is styled back. There is a window with small panes in the background, indicating the setting is likely indoors. In the foreground, there are two chests on the ground, one partially open and the other closed with decorative hinges.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a surreal scene depicted within an open clamshell. Inside the clamshell, various figures are huddled together, some holding musical instruments, others books, and one holding a platter. Above them, a figure is pointing upward. To the left of the clamshell, a figure is pouring liquid from a jug into a dish held just outside the shell. In the background, a barren tree emerges from the sea with perched birds, a hanging fish, and an owl. The distant background features a small boat and faint outlines of castle towers and rooftops. The detailed line work and imaginative composition suggest elements of satire or allegory, characteristic of 16th-century European art.
